featured_reviews.name: Omkar Kinkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Timezone at Phoenix Palladium is hands-down one of the best spots in Mumbai for a fun day out. Tucked away on the Third Floor of the East Wing, it is incredibly easy to find and offers a massive variety of games that keep both kids and adults thoroughly entertained.The arcade selection here is top-notch. They have the latest immersive VR games like Virtual Rabbids and Dark Mars VR, which are absolutely thrilling. Beyond video games, the social play options are fantastic. We had an incredible time hitting the bowling lanes and driving the bumper cars, making it the perfect spot to hang out with a group of friends or family. It is also a very popular party venue, and I saw a dedicated area set up for a kid’s birthday party which looked well-managed.What really sets this Timezone apart are their incredible weekday promotions. If you want to make your budget stretch further, planning a visit during the week is a must. On Half Price Tuesdays, all video and ticket games are 50% off. On Fun Treats Wednesdays, the attractions drop to half price. Thursdays are a steal with bowling for just ₹99 and select games for ₹9, and Friday evenings offer great reload bonuses on their app.The staff is friendly, the environment is high-energy, and redeeming Powertickets at the Prize Shop at the end of the day is always a rewarding experience. It gets busy on weekends, but the weekday deals make it completely worth a mid-week visit. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Smaaash is a great place if you’re looking for a solid gaming and entertainment experience. From bowling and cricket to go-karting, there’s a good mix of activities that can easily keep you engaged for 5–6 hours.

They also have 3–4 good VR experiences that are definitely worth trying. The arcade games are decent, but you can skip a few of them and spend that time (and money) on the bigger experiences instead.

featured_reviews.name: Pinkesh Kamwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Smaaash Lower Parel — Still Brings Out My Inner Child
I’ve been visiting Smaaash Lower Parel for more than a decade, and it’s one of those rare places that has managed to grow with time without losing its core charm.
Back in the day, it was all about adult-oriented fun — late nights, high energy, friends, and honestly, partying like an animal. The go-karting, especially at night, has always been a personal favourite, along with the bowling arenas, cricket box, and a wide mix of adrenaline-packed games that made it a go-to hangout spot.

Fun fact: I’ve literally celebrated every phase of life here — I even had a breakup party at Smaaash in 2014, which somehow makes my bond with this place even stronger 😄.

What I really appreciate now is how Smaaash has evolved over time. Initially, the focus was clearly more on adults, but lately they’ve done a great job of introducing kid-friendly games without taking away the excitement that adults come for.
Last night felt like a full-circle moment. I visited with my 11-year-old nephew and 7-year-old niece, and they absolutely loved it. From the games to the overall vibe, they were completely engaged and having a blast. Seeing the same place work just as well for kids today as it once did for us adults was genuinely satisfying.
Smaaash still does what it’s always done best ,it brings out your inner child, no matter your age. And now, with the younger generation hooked, I’m pretty sure I’ll be coming here regularly again.
A place full of memories, that adapts with time and still delivers fun... Smaaash Lower Parel continues to hit the mark.

featured_reviews.name: Dr Hrishikesh Doke
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited this kids' play zone and found that while the facilities are good, there are some areas that need improvement to enhance the overall experience and safety of children.

1. Overcrowding: The play area was extremely crowded in peak hours, making it difficult for children to enjoy the activities comfortably and safely. Limiting the number of visitors during peak hours or introducing timed slots could help.

2. Insufficient Care Staff: There appeared to be too few staff members supervising the play area. Additional attendants would help monitor children's safety, manage activities better, and assist parents when needed.

3. Parents Inside the Play Area: Many parents were sitting within the play zone itself, creating obstructions and reducing the available space for children to play freely.

Suggestions for Improvement:

- Implement a maximum occupancy limit.
- Increase the number of trained care staff during busy hours.
- Prepare guidelines for kids as well as parents.
- Regularly monitor crowd levels to ensure a safe and enjoyable environment.

With these improvements, the play zone can provide a much better experience for both children and parents.

featured_reviews.name: Shambhavi Paradkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently celebrated our daughter’s birthday at Funkey Monkey Playzone, and we are extremely happy with the entire experience. It was a well-managed and memorable event – truly paisa vasool!

Food:
The food arrangement was excellent – delicious, kid-friendly, and perfectly suited for the occasion. Many of our guests specifically complimented the taste and quality. We were also pleasantly surprised when the team offered us an additional main course dish complimentary, staying well within the agreed budget. A lovely gesture!

Decoration:
The decoration exceeded our expectations. The team went above and beyond by adding a few beautiful elements on their own, which weren’t part of the original plan. The combination of pastel shades looked elegant and festive. We really appreciate the extra effort!

Funkey Monkey Team:
A big shoutout to Samina and Neha, who were incredibly supportive and attentive throughout the planning and during the event. They ensured everything went smoothly and were always available when needed.

Play Area & Tattoo Artist:
The play area was a hit – not just for the kids, but for many of the adults too! The tattoo artist was a great addition, and even grown-ups joined in the fun. It really added to the lively and playful atmosphere.

Suggestions for Improvement:

It would be great if the food could be kept warm till the end of the party, as it was a bit cold by the time guests were eating.

The washroom area felt quite hot, which made it a bit uncomfortable while changing kids' clothes. Some ventilation or cooling would help.

Despite the couple of minor points, the entire experience was fantastic. Thank you so much to the entire Funkey Monkey team for making our daughter’s birthday so special. We highly recommend this venue for kids' parties and celebrations!

featured_reviews.review_text:
We discovered YEY Yaya Kids Club while we were in Bombay for shopping. My wife and I had our little one with us and he was getting bored, so we decided to try this place for about 1.5 hours (₹650) and honestly, it was completely worth every rupee.

The place is very well equipped and thoughtfully designed for kids. Right from the moment you enter, there’s so much for them to explore, trampoline, slides, climbing wall, crazy cars, a kids’ supermarket, kids’ salon, and even that fun bulldozer game where kids pick up balls like mud and slide down. My child didn’t get bored even for a minute.

They also have a big indoor play area, in-house café, and even paid games for extra fun. The space is clean, safe, colourful and very well managed. You can also host birthday parties here which we noticed a lot of parents doing, it’s a perfect setup for that.

What I really liked is that it gives parents a break while kids are happily engaged in a proper play environment. For us, it turned a tiring shopping day into a smooth one because our kid came out smiling and exhausted in the best way 😄

If you’re in Bombay with kids, this place is a life-saver.
Highly recommended. We’ll definitely be coming back. 👍

featured_reviews.name: Gerry Savage
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited on a weekday (Wednesday) but were charged the weekend entry price without any prior notice. It was not a government or national holiday. After being charged, I noticed the bill listed a weekend rate, and when I questioned it, I was told it was because of Pongal (which is not a national holiday). There were no signs, notices, or verbal mention before payment that weekend pricing would apply.
There are excessive restrictions throughout the facility (what children can do, what they can play with, and even how they’re allowed to play). In the pretend play area, costumes are not allowed to be removed from the spot and are only permitted for photos. My child was asked to remove a costume, yet there is no signage explaining this rule. If the area is for photos only, that should be clearly stated.
In the arcade, you only get one play. Several amenities were also not functioning, including the crane game and the rock-climbing area. Other areas were taped up, torn, or visibly run down, making the place feel poorly maintained and potentially unsafe.
There are also rules about where adults are allowed, but no clear indication of which areas are restricted. Overall, the staff managed the space in a very stern manner, which is not appropriate for a children’s play area.
Between the misleading weekday pricing, excessive and unclear rules, broken attractions, and poor maintenance, the experience was extremely disappointing. What was supposed to be a fun outing for my three-year-old turned into a frustrating and unpleasant experience. At best, the practices feel dishonest.
